messages:
maria.chen: FYI found something while doing a log sweep — a partner webhook payload in our staging S3 that includes a base64 blob that looks like a KMS envelope. not sure if it unwraps to creds. s3://redwood-staging-logs/partners/2026-03-19/ingest.log.gz
ajay.k: can you paste a redacted sample here? please remove any GUIDs or partner IDs before posting. do not run any decrypt in-channel.
maria.chen: pasted minimal sample (redacted):
```
PUT /webhook 200 - payload: {"data":"CiQAyGv...BASE64_ENVELOPE_TRUNCATED...=="}
```
leo.park: that looks like ciphertext from a KMS envelope. likely AWS/KMS or GCP-KMS wrapped data key. first steps: identify which key resource was used (check object metadata + CloudTrail/Cloud Audit logs). do NOT attempt decrypt in this thread.
sre-oncall: suggestion: snapshot the object to a secure bucket with restricted ACL, then remove the original public/less-restricted copy. commands for quick snapshot (aws):
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-staging-logs/partners/2026-03-19/ingest.log.gz s3://redwood-secure-evidence/ingest-1733456789.log.gz --acl bucket-owner-full-control
aws s3 rm s3://redwood-staging-logs/partners/2026-03-19/ingest.log.gz
```
sec-bot: Created ticket SEC-3098: partner webhook blob exposure — evidence collected and initial triage requested. assignees: @ajay.k, @leo.park. :rotating_light:
paula.r: we need an immediate POA to meet compliance windows. what are we rotating and who will notify the partner? also capture access logs (S3 access log + CloudTrail/Stackdriver) for the object time range.
devops.sam: proposed triage + rotation plan (short):
1) snapshot evidence to secure bucket (done by @sre-oncall)
2) collect audit logs for object and KMS operations (CloudTrail / Audit Logs) — @ajay.k
3) identify KMS key resource and check key policy & recent decrypt requests — @leo.park
4) rotate webhook secret (partner-side) and rotate any short-lived tokens we control — @devops.sam to coordinate with partner ops
5) consider rewrap of ciphertext with a new key if we confirm plaintext had secrets; full key rotation only if key material is compromised
6) create rotation + verification playbook and close SEC ticket
paula.r: timeline? we need rotation and partner notification within 4 hours if creds exposed. otherwise 24 hours for escalated incident.
ajay.k: collecting logs now. commands I'm running (GCP example):
```
gcloud logging read 'resource.type="gcs_bucket" AND protoPayload.request.uri:"ingest.log.gz"' --limit 50 --project=redwood-prod
gcloud kms keys versions list --location=global --keyring=partners --key=ingest-key
```
leo.park: if it's AWS KMS blob use: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=<key-arn>` and `aws kms list-grants --key-id <key-id>` to enumerate recent usage. also check for service account impersonation.
maria.chen: partner contact is jane@partnerco.com. i'm composing a minimal notification: "we observed a webhook payload containing an encrypted blob that may contain credentials; we've secured the evidence and request you rotate webhook secret ASAP." want to run by compliance before sending.
paula.r: send me the draft via DM, do NOT include any ciphertext in the email. compliance: we need affected scope, retention of evidence, and a signed acknowledgment from the partner after rotation.
sre-oncall: note: if partner can't rotate immediately, we should apply rate-limiting and block that webhook origin until rotation is confirmed.
devops.sam: rotation steps for partner (high level): generate new HMAC secret, update consumer key in partner dashboard, rotate any downstream tokens that were derived from that secret. if we control a service account that accepted the webhook, revoke that SA credentials immediately and issue new creds.
ajay.k: logs show a single PutObject from an external IP at 2026-03-19T03:12:45Z and a later ListObjects from an internal pipeline. no KMS Decrypt events in the same minute so far. attaching excerpt to SEC-3098.
leo.park: next safe step: we can rewrap ciphertext in an evidence vault (no decrypt) by generating a new envelope and re-encrypting the blob metadata as evidence if needed, but I'd prefer rekeying only after we confirm plaintext exposure.
compliance-bot: Reminder: incident classification form required within 2 hours for any potential credential leak. Link: https://redwood.internal/compliance/incidents
maria.chen: action items assigned: @sre-oncall snapshot+delete (in progress), @ajay.k collect audit logs (in progress), @devops.sam coordinate partner rotation (oncall), @leo.park validate KMS usage and key policy. aiming to have rotation started within 4 hours.
paula.r: thanks. please update SEC-3098 with timestamps and ownership. I'll prepare partner notification template once @maria.chen shares sanitized evidence. :white_check_mark:
sec-bot: SEC-3098 updated: evidence attached and timeline created. next update expected by 2026-03-19T07:30:00Z.
